doc: Gemini's content parts for a function call and its response, which Google GenAI, Vertex AI and ADK all write - a wire vocabulary rather than one instrumentation's. Each part comes in the API's camelCase and the Python SDK's snake_case; the two are separate rules, camelCase first, so a part holding both envelopes is read from one of them rather than mixing an id from one with a name from the other. Tried before every other declared case at this position, which is where the retired reader sat: after the other provider formats.

content_blocks.doc: A call, under the API's member name.

id.doc: Gemini states no call id, so one is built from the call: two calls of one function with different arguments get different ids, and the same call re-sent gets the same one.

content_blocks.doc: The same call under the Python SDK's member name, read only when the camelCase envelope is absent.

id.doc: Gemini states no call id, so one is built from the call: two calls of one function with different arguments get different ids, and the same call re-sent gets the same one.

content_blocks.doc: What the function returned, under the API's member name.

tool_result.doc: No call id: the feed's correlation pairs the result with its call by name, the only place both halves are visible at once.
name: $.functionResponse.name
